programmes.evidence: The research-intensive PhD in Business explicitly offers an Operations Management concentration, currently recruiting for Fall 2027. Its doctoral research covers design and improvement of manufacturing/service processes, supply chains, quality, retail/healthcare/platform operations and revenue management. The ISOM academic area is associated through the programme faculty listings.
limitations: Concentration recorded within the broad Business PhD, not a second separate degree. Academic area affiliation does not establish a separately constituted administrative doctoral department. Intake availability for other business concentrations is cycle-specific.
